# Papyrus BPApp

> Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) platform purpose-built for Indian paper manufacturers. 44 integrated modules covering production planning, deckle optimization, sales, GST-native finance, HR/payroll, quality, maintenance, AI and IoT — from order intake to e-invoice.

Papyrus BPApp ("Business Process Application") is a cloud-native ERP launched in 2024, designed specifically for the Indian paper industry. Unlike generic global ERPs (SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics) retrofitted for paper or Indian SMB tools (Tally, Marg) that lack mill-specific features, Papyrus BPApp is paper-first AND India-first from the ground up.

The platform's flagship differentiator is the **3-tier Deckle Optimizer** — a proprietary slitting trim-waste optimization engine that runs in three modes (Instant <2s, Balanced ~30s, Full ≤5 min with 180+ constraints). Real Indian mills report trim waste dropping from 8%+ to under 3.5%, equating to ₹2-3+ crore annual savings on a 50 TPD mill.

## Who it serves

Indian paper mills across all categories: writing & printing, kraft (packaging), tissue & towel, multi-ply board, specialty coated, newsprint, recycled, integrated pulp-paper mills, cooperative (sahakari) mills. Also serves paper converters, traders/distributors, job-work units, paper machinery OEMs, and EPC consultants.

Mill sizes: small (1-50 employees) to large multi-plant groups (500+ employees, multiple facilities).

## Key facts

- **Name**: Papyrus BPApp (Business Process Application)
- **Category**: Manufacturing ERP, MES, paper industry software
- **Founded**: 2024
- **Country**: India
- **Modules**: 44 integrated, organized into 6 groups
- **Capabilities**: 396+ documented features
- **Compliance**: GST-native (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, e-invoice, e-way bill), FEMA, TDS, TCS, PF, ESI, PT, LWF, Aadhaar Act
- **Languages**: English, Hindi, Tamil
- **Architecture**: Multi-tenant, API-first, event-driven, RBAC, full audit trails, horizontally scalable
- **Deployment**: Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) or on-premises
- **Stack**: Node.js + Express + PostgreSQL + Redis + BullMQ (backend); Next.js + Expo React Native (frontend/mobile)
- **Website**: https://bpapperp.papyrus360.com
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/anandaravi/BPAppWebPortal
- **YouTube playlist**: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLI8_1PmAsPBHPu4uD-b4Or0pAveJjYgry

## The 6 module groups

1. **Core Operations** (12 modules): Sales, Procurement, Production Planning (MPS/MRP/CRP), Stock Preparation, Deckle Optimizer, Converting & Finishing, Broke Management, Inventory, Quality, Maintenance, Lab Master, Recipe Development
2. **Customer Experience** (4 modules): CRM, Helpdesk, Marketing Automation, Field Service
3. **Finance & People** (2 modules): Finance & GST, HR & Payroll
4. **Master Data & Documents** (7 modules): Party Master, Product Catalog, Pricing, Lookups, Number Series, Documents, Engineering Change Management
5. **Intelligence & Automation** (7 modules): AI Engine, Automations, Approvals, RPA, Voice, Document Intelligence, Mobile
6. **Platform & Industry 4.0** (12 modules): Administration, RBAC, Audit, Email Hub, Notifications, Monitoring, Projects, Business Profile, IoT Devices, Digital Twin, Sustainability, Edge Computing

## Comparisons

- **vs Greycon (X-Trim, GreyconMill)**: Greycon is the global deckle/trim optimization leader, generally on-prem and point-product focused. Papyrus BPApp includes deckle optimization as part of a full integrated ERP, cloud-native, India-built, India-priced.
- **vs SAP S/4HANA Mill Products**: SAP is enterprise-scale with global breadth but long implementation cycles, high TCO, and requires extensive India-compliance customization. Papyrus BPApp goes live in weeks, includes Indian compliance natively, and is purpose-built for paper.
- **vs Tally / Marg / Busy**: These are accounting-first Indian SMB tools, not manufacturing ERPs. Papyrus BPApp covers their accounting scope plus full production, quality, maintenance, HR/payroll, AI, IoT.
- **vs Honeywell Optivision / ABB Ability / Valmet IIoT**: These are control-system and MES platforms from automation OEMs. Papyrus BPApp integrates with them (via IoT module) and adds the ERP/business layer.
